messages:
maya: Quick sync — need the final changelog + docs links for tomorrow's announce (09:00 PT). Also want the benchmark narrative and a webinar slot confirmed. Who can lock links? :spiral_calendar:
leo: I can grab the changelog. Putting draft up now: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/drafts/v2.0-changelog — will update with final perf numbers by EOD.
sam: For rollout timing, engineering prefers a phased canary 09:00->10:30 PT then full rollout at 11:00 PT if no errors. Is that ok for marketing?
maya: That works. We'll soft-post to early access customers at 09:10 and press + product blog at 11:05. Need the docs stable link before 10:50 so we don't have link rot.
emily: Webinar ask — we have a 25-min slot 3/24 10:00 PT with product marketing and a short benchmark demo. Do we want to announce webinar on launch or wait 24h?
dave: Recommend announce with launch as "Register to see the benchmark walkthrough" — helps inbound right away. We'll route attendees to SDR queue tag `launch-webinar-mar24`.
sam: Added rollout timeline to internal infra runbook. If canary fails, fallback to v1 model in config. Deploy bot will post status.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 2026-03-24T09:00:00-07:00 (canary ID c-2165). Auto-roll back threshold = 3% error rate.
leo: Final perf numbers: 95th pctl latency 180ms, cost/unit down 12% with batch caching. Adding these to the benchmark narrative doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/embeddings-latency-mar24
maya: Perfect. Can someone paste the final changelog link here when it's merged? I want to pin in the release tweet + announcement doc.
leo: Changelog merged: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.0/changelog — includes migration notes, breaking changes for older dedicated configs.
emily: Messaging iteration: headline options in the draft doc — A) "Faster inference, lower cost" B) "Predictable performance across envs" — leaning A for social, B for enterprise emails. Thoughts?
dave: Use A on social and blog, B in the enterprise pack + outreach sequences. Also confirm inbound routing: HubSpot form will set `source=launch_v2` and `priority=warm`.
maya: Great. Last ask — anyone can approve the launch blog by 17:30 PT? I'll assemble final assets (screens, graf, quotes).
leo: I'll review by 17:00 and sign off.
sam: Eng ok on no post-launch hotfixes in first 2 hours unless critical.
emily: I'll schedule social posts and email batch once I get final links. Thanks team :tada:
